title.title: Amazon music presents Ongaku Nou Tankyuu Salon Watcha! Watcha!
title.overview:
Amazon Music presents a new regular music program for music fans, airing on Space Shower TV!

The MCs are an unpredictable trio: Sho Ayakoji (Kishidan), Angelina 1/3 (Gacharic Spin), and the mysterious character “Mr. Brain,” who possesses extensive musical knowledge.

The show's theme is ‘Introducing all kinds of music through the program's unique perspective to stimulate your musical brain.’ It features watch parties with guest musicians, covers the latest hit charts and music news, and will be streamed live monthly from Amazon Music.

Space Shower TV will air a condensed 90-minute version of the live streamed program!
